caption: The drawing depicts a single long dress, centrally positioned against a plain, light beige background. The dress is rendered in shades of tan and light brown, showing texture and folds to give the appearance of fabric. It has long, slightly puffed sleeves and a high, rounded neckline. The bodice is detailed with subtle seam lines and fitted sections, while the skirt is gathered just below the bust, creating an empire waist. The skirt falls to full length with visible folds that suggest a soft, flowing material. There are no additional objects or patterns, and the primary focus is on the detailed depiction of the dress itself.
title: Wedding Dress
